subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• A supply chain is the network of processes connecting the production and distribution of a product in the global marketplace.
• Mexican economist Elena Vargas studies the contemporary supply chain of avocados.
• At one end of the avocado chain are small farmers in rural Mexico.
• At the other end are health-conscious consumers who purchase premium avocados in U.S. supermarkets.
• According to Vargas, "American demand for avocados exploded in the 1990s, when health benefits of the fruit became widely publicized."
prompt: The student wants to provide an overview of the avocado supply chain. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The contemporary avocado supply chain has its origins in the 1990s when, according to Vargas, "health benefits of the fruit became widely publicized."
choices.B: Supply chains include the networked production and distribution of products, such as avocados, in the global marketplace.
choices.C: Health-conscious consumers who purchase premium avocados in U.S. supermarkets are at one end of the avocado supply chain.
choices.D: Decades after American demand for avocados surged, a supply chain now links small farmers in rural Mexico with health-conscious consumers purchasing premium avocados in U.S. supermarkets.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence provides an overview of the avocado supply chain, connecting the Mexican farmers at one end to the American consumers at the other.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. While the sentence mentions the avocado supply chain, it focuses only on one end of the chain (the consumers); it does not provide an overview.
